remote_executor
properties.summary: INTERFACE: an environment that runs code (the operator, 2026-10-10). An entity that implements it is ISA remote_executor and brings its own exec(code, timeout): the command that carries {{code}} into THAT environment. Describe the environment on the entity: lang (sh, jinja, js...), env (what it is and what it can reach), trust (who must approve a run). members_of('remote_executor') = every place code can run.
